metadata.scope: GT2/GT3 timing pulleys, idler pulleys, V-belt sheaves, belt tension calculations.

material_suggestions.notes: Best surface finish for belt engagement; light; anodise for wear.
Self-lubricating; good for belt contact surfaces.
PA12 preferred; increase $fn to tooth_count × 4 for smooth tooth form.

standards_used.name: GT2 belt profile
standards_used.note: pitch 2.0 mm, tooth height ≈ 0.75 mm, tooth radius 0.555 mm.

standards_used.name: GT2 pitch diameter formula
standards_used.note: pitch_d = teeth × 2.0 / PI. 20T GT2: pitch_d = 12.73 mm, OD ≈ 14.8 mm.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: GT2 20-tooth timing pulley

fit_guidance_mm.bore: shaft_d + 0.1 for press; + 0.2 for running fit

main_features: main pulley rim cylinder at pitch diameter
two flanges at top and bottom of belt width
hub cylinder extending for bore engagement
simplified tooth features around pitch circle
design_rules: pitch_d computed from teeth and pitch — not from bore
flanges larger than pulley_od to retain belt
teeth are subtractive or additive features around pitch circle
set-screw hole perpendicular to bore aimed at bore center
hub extends beyond belt width for secure shaft grip
validation_criteria: flanges at both ends of belt width
failure_modes: pitch_d equal to bore_d — completely wrong
set-screw missing — pulley slips on shaft

constraint_checks.message: GT2 pulley pitch diameter must be derived from teeth × pitch / PI.
Timing pulley should have flanges to retain the belt.
